text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: eager-mode PyTorch. Thus, we need to be careful about any CPU overhead in this method. For example, `view` and `slice`

svg.text: (or `[:n]`) operations are surprisingly slow even in the case they do not invoke any GPU ops. … Whenever making a

svg.text: change in this method, please benchmark the performance to make sure it does not introduce any overhead.
